:::{#sol-naturals-below-three}

The answer depends on whether the source counts $0$ as a natural number:

- if $\Nat$ starts at $0$, the set is $\cb{0, 1, 2}$;
- if $\Nat$ starts at $1$, the set is $\cb{1, 2}$.

Both conventions are in common use,
so the answer is not the same in every textbook.

:::
